notablePrerequisites:
Gigantoplasm on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Gigantoplasm do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Gigantoplasm.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Gigantoplasm.
Activate Gigantoplasm by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Gigantoplasm ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
